_what_this_is: Every image committed under visual/assets, with the sha256 of the bytes and the role those bytes play. brief.asset_manifest() reads it; brief.approved_portrait() refuses to hand out a face whose bytes do not match the approved_face entry; freeze.reference_paths() refuses any reference whose bytes do not match the frozen pack's reference_hashes. Roles: approved_face is the one face the owner approved on 2026-09-22 and the only committed asset a render may be conditioned on; superseded_body frames are the pre-revision body the owner replaced and are never a fallback reference; owner_concept is the owner's own generated concept, the direction the pack was built from, and not the model.

assets.note: the neutral portrait the owner approved as the target face; carried into every reference pack unchanged and placed as reference_image on the frozen canonical row

assets.superseded_by: the revised torso_fit_reference frame of the frozen pack, held in the DurableArtifact store and referenced by sha256 in model_identities.image_refs
assets.note: pre-revision body frame kept only so the bust revision could be measured against it; forbidden as a fallback reference
